description:
## Origin

CATO observation c3 during Arc 38 review (PR #18 → main 0b5f7f3). Surfaced as architectural follow-up at the time per CATO's own recommendation ("Out of A20 hard-locks; raise as architectural follow-up"). Filed post-arc per PLINY routing decision.

## Concern

`substrate/install.sh write_substrate_manifest` declares format "<deployed-relative-path>\t<token>\t<replacement>" as a comment in the manifest header itself, but the manifest reader in `apply_substitutions_from_manifest` (check.sh + apply.sh) does NOT verify a format-version. If a future install.sh bumps the format (adds a column, changes the separator), check.sh + apply.sh readers will silently produce wrong substitutions or skip entries.

## Proposed fix

- Add an explicit format-version header line in the manifest (e.g., `# format=v1` as first non-comment line after the existing metadata header).
- Make `apply_substitutions_from_manifest` parse the version line and reject unknown versions with a clear user-facing error directing the operator to update check-substrate-updates skill (or re-deploy with a matching install.sh version).
- Update install.sh write_substrate_manifest to emit the version line.
- Cite-comments at write site + both read sites naming the version contract.

## Out of scope (Arc 38 framing)

Per A20 hard-lock "DO NOT restructure check-substrate-updates beyond what bj5 requires". This is forward-looking robustness rather than a bj5-scope deliverable.

## Cross-refs

- Arc 38 PR #18 (main 0b5f7f3) shipped the manifest scheme without versioning
- stoa--bj5 (closed Arc 38) — the parent feature
- substrate/install.sh:392-400 (write_substrate_manifest header)
- substrate/skills/check-substrate-updates/check.sh:151-176 (apply_substitutions_from_manifest reader)
- substrate/skills/check-substrate-updates/apply.sh:108-150 (parallel reader)

## Sequencing

P3. Architectural follow-up; not urgent. Land when a forward arc has reason to evolve the manifest format OR when a separate arc fences off check-substrate-updates skill hardening.
title: Manifest format-version header + reader version-check (CATO c3 Arc 38 follow-up)
